scope: Author review of the additive M1578 RTL K8 versus mapped ARCH_MODE1 case0 four-state first-fault diagnostic source. No compile, simulation, UCLI, initreg, SAIF, PTPX, attempt consumption, commit, or push.
author_findings: The stimulus is the frozen M979 K8 case0 identity: tag 0x979000, four raw beats, window depth two, and one output block.
The RTL and mapped DUTs share stimulus and external backpressure schedules but own independent instances of the identical reset-safe memory model.
protocol_error, numeric_overflow, and stale_response_seen are printed independently as 0, 1, or X; the eight endpoint bits and six named internal taps remain visible per DUT.
The trace records header, source, endpoint request, memory response, commit, and done events on every observed edge and stops at the first fault/X or RTL-mapped difference.
No X is coerced to zero, and no force/release, UCLI, initreg, SVA runtime, SAIF, or PTPX mechanism is present in the active source or filelist.
The package is diagnostic-only and provides no RTL PASS, mapped PASS, timing, power, PPA, speedup, or paper-citable result.
